title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.target: Sociodemographic bias (Culture, Gender, Ethnicity, Religion, Class)
bias_targets.methodology: While the paper does not conduct a direct bias evaluation study, it introduces and validates a methodological measurement device (PUN: Plausible Unknown Names). This protocol generates operationally unknown names to be used as controlled prompt variables (e.g., via counterfactual name substitution) so researchers can evaluate name-conditioned social and demographic biases in LLMs without the confound of memorized, exact-name evidence.
